description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own customer deployments from initial data access through to a trusted system that delivers measurable business outcomes. This founding role brings together data engineering, applied AI, and customer success, while building reusable tools and frameworks to improve future deployments.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work with revenue and operations leaders to understand business objectives and identify valuable problems to solve.

 - Scope customer data access, navigate undocumented warehouse schemas, and map them to business concepts.

 - Interview data and business teams to establish consistent definitions and validate the resulting ontology.

 - Build customer-facing signals and workflows, including custom agent setups, and diagnose and improve their outputs.

 - Define success measures up front and develop analysis that demonstrates customer impact.

 - Turn deployment learnings into reusable validation frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and mapping tools.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role, such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or software engineering with substantial customer exposure.

 - An engineering background or substantive applied data science capabilities. Data-engineering-only and solutions-engineering-only experience are not sufficient.

 - Fluency with data warehouses, SQL, and dbt, including navigating undocumented schemas.

 - Applied statistics or machine learning experience, with a quantitative degree or comparable background and working knowledge of distributions, seasonality, validation design, and calibration.

 - Experience building custom agent configurations beyond default implementations.

 - Ability to resolve conflicting business definitions through interviews and validation, and to define success metrics and demonstrate customer outcomes.

 - Experience in an early-stage startup, or a combination of large-company and startup or founder experience. A stable employment history and comfort with ambiguity are important.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, United States.
